prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1124; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
text: Inspection of the rear bumper cover, left quarter panel, and tail lamp assembly shows damage consistent with the reported low-speed impact in the parking lot. Contact points line up with one another, and the pattern is what I would expect from the described event. A few faint scratches along the lower door edge appear older than this incident, possibly from prior wear, and have been noted separately from the new repair scope. The proposed plan covers replacing the bumper cover, repairing and refinishing the quarter panel, and replacing the lamp assembly. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the work. Billing reviewed so far shows no repeated charges for the same operation.
